title: Residency guardrails: tenant pin priority, retention overrides, and evidence lifecycle
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Add tenant-level controls that allow operators to pin API traffic to ordered region priorities, define per-tenant retention overrides, and generate tamper-evident audit evidence bundles for compliance reviews. Deliver UI, API, and automated evidence export pipeline.
background: Customers in regulated industries require deterministic residency (not just routing hints) and machine-verifiable proof that data and derived artifacts were processed and retained in accordance with contracts. Existing region pinning is coarse and lacks retention overrides and a standardized evidence artifact for audits.
goals: Allow tenant admins to declare ordered region preferences (primary, fallback) that the hosted API will honor when provisioning and routing requests
Expose retention_hold/retention_delete controls per tenant with per-data-type granularity (logs, request payloads, embeddings)
Produce verifiable evidence bundles (signed manifests + policy tight snapshots) for a requested audit window
Surface controls in Console and via API; support RBAC and SSO workflows
out_of_scope: Legal attestation content beyond machine-generated evidence
requirements: API: POST/PUT /tenants/{id}/residency with ordered regions and priority weights
API: PATCH /tenants/{id}/retention with TTLs and exemptions list
Console: tenant settings page with region order drag/drop and retention editors
Evidence generator that composes signed manifest, storage hashes, and request sampling index
Retention enforcement engine that garbage-collects artifacts according to per-tenant policies
api_contract: Design doc: /confluence/infra/pm/residency-api-v1 (draft). Contract must return 202 on policy acceptance, and provide a policy_id for evidence queries. Evidence API: GET /tenants/{id}/evidence?from=&to=&policy_id=
ui_flow: Drag to reorder regions; set fallback windows and notify SLA effect
Toggle per-data-type retention with 'apply immediately' or 'phase in' options
Evidence tab to request bundle and view readiness status
acceptance_criteria: Tenant can create a residency policy with ordered regions and the policy_id is persisted
Retention overrides are applied and expired artifacts are purged according to TTL in staging cluster
Evidence bundle can be requested and returns a signed manifest with SHA256 hashes and policy snapshot
E2E test demonstrates routing preference honored under simulated regional outage
tasks: Finalize API spec and open API/SDK PRs
Implement Console components and write Cypress tests
Build evidence composition worker and signing key rotation strategy
Add telemetry for routed-region, honor-rate, and retention-compliance metrics
Perform internal security review and record findings
test_plan: Unit tests for policy creation and validation
Integration test: create tenant with policy, send requests from multiple regions, verify routed-region header
Retention validation: create test artifacts, advance time, run GC, verify deletion
Evidence validation: request bundle, verify manifest signatures and file hashes match stored blobs
rollout_plan: Beta with compliance customers and SEs for two weeks
Collect feedback and iterate on defaults
Gradual ramp to all new tenants, existing tenants must opt-in or migrate via migration tool
monitoring_and_metrics: honor_rate: fraction of requests routed to top-priority region
evidence_request_latency: time between request and bundle availability
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: inconsistency between routing and storage locations leading to audit failures -> Mitigation: pre-deploy consistency checks and end-to-end E2E tests
Risk: evidence bundles expose sensitive metadata -> Mitigation: encrypt evidence bundles at rest and restrict access via RBAC
Risk: region capacity constraints cause slippage -> Mitigation: add fallback policies and quota alerts
notes: Design review scheduled 2026-02-22; initial feedback requires clearer error states in Console
Consider adding local test harness for customers to validate residency prior to opt-in
